items.name: DynamicFilterTracking
items.summary: Classification of a predicate according to the dynamic filters it contains.

methods.name: classify
methods.summary: Walk `predicate` once and classify its dynamic-filter content, subscribing to every filter that is not yet complete.

methods.name: contains_dynamic_filter
methods.summary: `true` if the predicate contains any dynamic filter (complete or not), i.e. its value may differ from what was known at planning time and is therefore worth re-evaluating at least once.

methods.name: watcher
methods.summary: Mutable access to the underlying tracker when there is still something to watch.

items.name: DynamicFilterTracker
items.summary: Watches every still-incomplete [`DynamicFilterPhysicalExpr`] reachable from a predicate and reports, cheaply, whether any of them has been updated since the last check.

methods.name: changed
methods.summary: Returns `true` if any watched filter's expression has advanced since the previous call.
